messages:
matt-support: FYI ticket #5421 — customer claims invoice INV-98765 is on hold because reverse-charge wasn't applied. They say their EU VAT ID validates in VIES but our billing UI shows "invalid". Customer copy: "Our VAT ID BE0123456789 is valid — please reissue net invoice."

jess-billing: URG — pulling the invoice now. I see status=held, reason="VAT ID invalid". No resale cert attached in attachments. Can we confirm VIES lookup result?

taxbot: Automated VIES check for BE0123456789 at 1924681245 -> response: 502 Bad Gateway (VIES service timeout). Cached last successful lookup: 2023-11-02T08:12:03Z -> valid.

matt-support: So intermittent VIES failures are triggering auto-hold. Customer insists it's valid, and attached a screenshot of their national VAT cert in email (PDF). They've asked for a manual override so the invoice isn't blocked.

jess-billing: We need 2 things to proceed: (1) confirm entity name matches billing account, (2) have a copy of the resale certificate/registry lookup in our billing case. If both OK, we can flip exemption flag and reissue invoice net. I can do a manual override but want legal sign-off for reverse-charge for large amounts.

raj-legal: @jess-billing please paste the invoice subtotal and buyer legal name. For EU reverse-charge we need: buyer VAT ID, company legal name as on certificate, and evidence of B2B relationship. Also check country of VAT (BE here). If certificate is national (local certificate), ensure it matches registry.

liam-customer-success: I messaged the customer asking for the resale certificate PDF and a statement that they're buying for business (not consumer). They replied with PDF named "VL-BE-2025-1234.pdf" and their company name "Vanguard Logistics NV".

jess-billing: Received the PDF. Quick sanity checks: VAT ID BE0123456789 -> normalized form should be BE0123456789 (we strip spaces). But our VIES check failing due to 502. Repro steps for internal devs:
```
# repro VIES timeout
curl -s -X POST https://vies.example.eu/check -d '{"vat":"BE0123456789"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -I
# check our billing service log
kubectl logs -n billing svc-billing --since=1h | grep "VIES"
```

sara-ops: Noted — VIES upstream has been flaky. We saw increased 502/504s around the same window. Suggestion: temporarily allow manual override for cases where we have an explicit resale cert attached AND the last successful VIES check for same VAT ID within 30 days. That reduces fraud risk.

taxbot: Last successful VIES signature match for BE0123456789 -> 1709385123 (2024-03-01). That is within 30 days? No, that's older. But customer-supplied national PDF appears valid from visual inspection.

raj-legal: If the PDF shows the exact legal name and VAT ID, legal OK to approve manual reverse-charge for one-off invoices under 50k EUR. For amounts >50k we need additional KYC. What's invoice amount?

jess-billing: INV-98765 subtotal = 12,450 EUR. Under threshold. I can do manual override once legal confirms name match. Steps for override (internal):
1) Upload certificate file to billing case (already done).
2) In Billing Admin UI -> Invoice -> select INV-98765 -> click "Mark VAT Exempt (Manual)" -> add reason and attach evidence.
3) Recompute taxes and reissue invoice net.

Do not run SQL directly. Use admin UI to preserve audit trail.

raj-legal: Confirmed: PDF shows "Vanguard Logistics NV" and VAT BE0123456789. Company registered address matches account. Legal approves manual reverse-charge for this invoice. Please include note: "Reverse charge approved by Legal (raj-legal) based on uploaded resale certificate VL-BE-2025-1234.pdf."

jess-billing: On it. Performing override at 1924682500...

billing-bot: Action log: user=jess-billing performed=manual_vat_override invoice=INV-98765 reason="Customer provided resale certificate; VIES timeout" evidence=VL-BE-2025-1234.pdf timestamp=1924682500

jess-billing: Reissued invoice as INV-98765-NET, sent to billing email on file. Customer notified. Marking ticket resolved pending customer confirmation.

matt-support: Thanks team. Follow-ups: sara-ops — can we implement a short-term rule to avoid auto-holding when VIES returns 5xx and there is a certificate attachment? And long-term: cache positive VIES responses per VAT ID for 7 days.

sara-ops: Agree. I'll open infra ticket to adjust hold policy and add a short-lived cache for 24h as emergency mitigation. Long-term caching needs product approval (risk of stale changes).

liam-customer-success: Customer replied: "Thanks — we received the net invoice and payment will be issued today. Appreciate the quick help." :thumbsup:

matt-support: Closing thread, tagging for follow-up: #infra-ticket-824 (sara-ops) and #billing-policy for docs update. Cheers.
